blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding characteristics and activities of individuals in complex multi-person environments is crucial for real-world applications. However, existing datasets often simplify this problem to grounded group activity recognition, single-person activity recognition, or close-set activity recognition, thus limiting the generalizability of models trained on these datasets. In this work, we introduce the task of Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition (GHADAR), which involves describing the characteristics and activity descriptions of \textbf{every} person in a video, provided the location of the person in the video, which is more practical for real-world applications. To facilitate this, we introduce a new dataset derived from AVA-Actions by generating open-set captions for the person description and activity. In addition, we propose a novel method to effectively utilize the information contained in grounding during training by constraining the cross-attention masks during training in VLMs to improve performance for this task. Our experiments show that our method outperforms SOTA VLMs on this task. Finally, we demonstrate the limitations of existing evaluation metrics, which are overly reliant on human-annotations and exact text-text matching. As an added video-based evaluation, we propose a holistic VLM-based evaluation schema that compares concepts {\em directly} between the video and the generated predictions. Thus, in this work, we develop a complete framework for GHADAR, including a dataset, a novel method and an evaluation schema, thereby establishing a strong foundation for future research in this domain.
blocks.zh: 了解个人在复杂的多人环境中的特点和活动对于现实世界的应用至关重要。 然而,现有的数据集往往将这个问题简化为基于群体活性识别,单人活性识别,或近地设定活性识别,从而限制了在这些数据集上接受过培训的模型的通俗性. 在这部作品中,我们引入了"地基人类属性描述和活动识别(GHADAR)"(GHADAR)的任务,该任务涉及在视频中描述\textbf{Every}人物的特征和活动描述,提供视频中人物的位置,这对现实世界的应用更为实用. 为了促进这一点,我们采用了从AVA-Actions中衍生出的新数据集,为人物描述和活动生成开放的设置标题. 此外,我们建议采用一种新的方法来有效利用培训期间的入地信息,在培训期间限制交叉注意力口罩,以提高这项工作的绩效。 我们的实验表明,我们的方法在这项工作上超过了SOTA VLM. 最后,我们显示了现有评价衡量尺度的局限性,它们过分依赖人文说明和准确的文本匹配。 作为额外的基于视频的评价,我们提出一个基于VLM的整体评价计划,在视频和生成的预测之间将概念作一比较。 因此,在这项工作中,我们为GHADAR开发了一个完整的框架,包括一个数据集,一个新的方法和一个评价计划,从而为该领域的未来研究奠定坚实的基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The rapid progress of vision–language models (VLMs) has expanded the scope of computer vision from recognition to rich, multimodal understanding. Modern applications increasingly demand systems that can not only detect people in complex scenes, realized using powerful detectors like YOLO ( [ 31 ] ) and DINO ( [ 35 ] ), but also describe their appearance, attribute fine - grained characteristics, and recognize ongoing activities in an open - set manner ( [ 29 , 11 , 6 , 9 , 16 ] ). Such human - attributed understanding is critical for intelligent home assistants, autonomous surveillance and checkout systems [ 26 , 27 ] , and assistive technologies ( [ 29 ] ).
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的迅速进展,扩大了计算机视觉的范围,从认识到丰富的多式联运理解。 现代应用越来越需要各种系统,这些系统不仅能够探测复杂场景中的人,能够使用YOLO([31])和DINO([35])等强大的探测器实现,而且还能描述其外观,属性精细-粒状特征,并以开放-设定的方式识别正在进行的活动([29,11,6,9,16]). 这种人为理解对智能家庭助理、自主监督和检查系统[26、27]和辅助技术([29])至关重要。

blocks.en: We formalize this challenge as Grounded Human - Attributed Description and Activity Recognition (GHADAR): given the spatial location of people in a video (via bounding box), the goal is to generate two open - set captions — one describing each person’s attributes (e.g., an elderly man in white on the street, a child in blue uniform) and one describing their activity (e.g., attempting to cross a road, playing on the footpath). This formulation demands per - person reasoning in multi - actor scenes, integrating both local appearance cues and broader contextual signals.
blocks.zh: 我们正式确定这项挑战为 " 地面人类属性描述和活动识别 " :鉴于视频中人的空间位置(通过捆绑框),目标是产生两个开放式的、设定的字幕——一个描述每个人的属性(例如街上一名身着白色的老人,一名身着蓝色制服的儿童)和一个描述他们的活动(例如试图穿越道路,在人行道上玩耍)。 这种提法要求在多角色场景中逐人推理,结合局部外观提示和更广泛的背景信号.

blocks.en: Traditionally, research efforts in this direction have typically reduced the complexity of human-centric video understanding due to the scarcity of annotated data as shown in Figure 1 . For example, some works reduce this task to understanding the activity of a group of people as a whole or generating one caption for the entire video ( [ 13 ] ). Meanwhile, some other works reduce the scope of activity recognition to a closed set of limited action labels ( [ 16 , 4 , 20 ] ) or focus exclusively on single-person scenarios ( [ 33 ] ). In response, this paper introduces a new dataset called AVA-Captions, which extends AVA - Actions ( [ 9 ] ) with open - set, per - person captions for both attributes and activities, and involves multi-person interactions. Starting from AVA - Actions’ per - person action labels, we employ a high - capacity VLM (Nova Pro v1 ( [ 1 ] )) to generate natural - language descriptions, followed by identity - aware deduplication via person re - identification. This enables training and evaluation of models on the proposed task.
blocks.zh: 传统上,如图1所示,由于缺少附加说明的数据,这方面的研究工作通常减少了以人为中心的视频理解的复杂性。 例如,有些作品将这项任务缩减为理解整个人群的活动或为整个视频生成一个标题([13]). 同时,一些其他作品将活动识别范围缩减为封闭的一组有限动作标签([16,4,20]),或者只专注于单人情景([33]). 对此,本文引入了名为AVA-Captions的新数据集,扩展了AVA - Actions ([9]),对属性和活动都有开放式的-set,per-人标题,并涉及多人互动. 从 AVA - 动作的人均动作标签开始, 我们使用高容量的 VLM (Nova Pro v1 ([1]))生成自然-语言描述,然后是身份 - 了解通过人再-身份复制. 这有助于就拟议任务开展培训和评价模式。

blocks.en: We further propose Constrained Attention Masking - based Pretraining (CAMP) , a two - stage training strategy for VLMs that explicitly leverages grounding information. In Phase 1, we constrain the attention mask of the output tokens to the visual tokens within an expanded bounding box around the target person, enforcing localized reasoning. In Phase 2, we remove constraints and fine - tune at a reduced learning rate, allowing the model to integrate global context without eroding its person - specific focus.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步提议,基于 " 预训 " (CAMP)的 " 限制注意力 " 培训战略是 " 二级培训战略 " ,明确利用基础信息。 在第一阶段,我们把输出符的注意力罩限制在目标人周围一个扩大的边框内的视觉符,执行局部推理. 在第二阶段,我们以较低的学习率消除制约和微调,使模式能够结合全球环境,而不会削弱其个人 -- -- 具体重点。

blocks.en: Finally, we critique existing evaluation metrics in person and activity description. These metrics are largely text-text comparisons based on n-grams (BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE) ( [ 22 , 3 , 18 ] ), or similarity between embeddings from pretrained models (SBERT, CLIP) ( [ 24 , 25 ] ). Thus, these metrics often penalize semantically correct predictions that diverge lexically from human-annotated ground truth ( [ 21 ] ). To address this, we introduce a VLM-driven evaluation framework that directly compares conceptual alignment between the raw video content and the model prediction from the lens of completeness, uniqueness and correctness of the caption. In summary, our contributions are: 1. Task and Dataset : We define the task of Grounded Human - Attributed Description and Activity Recognition (GHADAR) and release AVA - Captions, the first large - scale dataset with open - set, per - person appearance and activity captions grounded in video. 2. Method : We propose CAMP, a two - stage attention - masking pretraining strategy that explicitly leverages grounding for improved per - person reasoning. 3. Evaluation : We design a VLM - based video–prediction alignment protocol to complement classical text - matching metrics. 4. Results : We demonstrate consistent gains over strong VLM baselines on AVA - Captions and the publicly available HC - STVG v2 ( [ 30 ] ) datasets, across both standard and proposed metrics.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们批评了现有的评价衡量尺度和活动说明。 这些衡量标准主要是基于n克(BLEU,METEOR,ROUGE)([22,3,18])的文本对比,或者来自预先训练过的模型(SBERT,CLIP)([24,25])的嵌入物之间的相似性. 因此,这些衡量标准往往会惩罚在逻辑上与人所说明的基本事实相左的客观正确的预测([21])。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一个由VLM驱动的评价框架,从标题的完整性、独特性和正确性的角度,直接比较原始视频内容与模型预测之间的概念一致。 总之,我们的贡献是: 1. 任务和数据集: 我们界定了地面人类属性描述和活动识别(GHADAR)的任务,并发布了AVA - Captions,这是第一套大型规模数据集,带有开放式-集,人均外观和基于视频的活动字幕. 2. 方法:我们提出CAMP,一种两阶段的注意----掩盖培训前策略,明确利用这一策略改进个人推理。 3. 评价: 我们设计了一个基于VLM的视频-预测对齐协议,以补充经典文本-匹配的度量衡. 4. 结果: 我们表明,相对于AVA的强VLM基线----说明和可公开获取的HC-STVG v2([30])数据集而言,无论是标准指标还是拟议指标,都取得了持续的进展。

blocks.en:
Existing Datasets: While we are among the first to propose grounded appearance and activity captions for every person in a video, this task has been explored in various relaxed settings in the literature. We tabulate some related datasets and their characteristics in Table 1 .HC - STVG ( [ 30 ] ) contains multi - person video clips but annotates only a single target individual per clip. It provides natural - language descriptions of the subject’s appearance and activity, along with frame - level bounding boxes, making it the closest existing benchmark to our setting. This dataset comes closest to our use case and hence, we also include results on this dataset in our experiments. VidSTG ( [ 36 , 28 ] ) is not a human-centric dataset and contains location captions for inanimate objects for most videos. In addition, it does not have person descriptions. ActivityNet Entities ( [ 40 ] ) is not strictly human-centric but it is easy to filter out the other object annotations. However, it does not offer grounding information for all frames and a majority of the videos contain only one person in the field of view. AVA-Actions ( [ 9 ] ) has frame-wise annotations per person. However, it does not have person descriptions and only provides action labels for 80 comprehensive, predetermined classes. We use this dataset to generate natural language descriptions for the person and their activity using these action labels. AVA-Kinetics ( [ 16 ] ) does not have open-set captions nor does it have bounding boxes for the persons in the video. RefAVA [ 23 ] extends AVA-Actions by adding manually-annotated open set person descriptions. However, it does not provide open-set captions for human actions, which are required for understanding person-object interactions.
Finally, MEVA ( [ 8 ] ) is a human-and-group-centric datasets that has activity labels for individuals and group activities. However, this dataset offers a very limited range of activities and is more specific for the use-cases of surveillance. In summary, existing datasets either lack open - set captions, omit per - person grounding, or restrict to single - person or closed - set scenarios — motivating the need for AVA - Captions.
blocks.zh:
现有数据集: 虽然我们是第一个在视频中为每个人提出有根据的外表和活动说明的人,但在文献中各种放松的场合中探讨了这项任务。 我们在表1HC-STVG([30])中将一些相关数据集及其特征列表,包含多人视频剪辑,但只标注每个剪辑的单个目标个人. 它提供自然语言描述对象的外观和活动,以及框架-线框,使其成为最接近我们设定的现有基准。 这个数据集最接近于我们的使用案例,因此,我们也将这个数据集的结果纳入了我们的实验中. VidSTG([36,28])不是一个以人为中心的数据集,包含大多数视频对无生命物体的位置标题. 此外,它没有人物描述。 活动网实体([40])严格来说不是以人为中心,但很容易从其他对象说明中过滤出来. 然而,它并没有为所有帧提供基础信息,大多数视频只包含一个观众。 AVA-Actions ([9]) 每人有框架说明. 但是,它没有人物描述,只为80个全面、预先确定的类别提供了动作标签。 我们使用这个数据集来生成使用这些动作标签的人及其活动的自然语言描述. AVA-Kinetics ([16]) 既没有开放字幕,也没有为视频中的人设置边框. RefAVA [23] 扩展了AVA-Actions,增加了手动附加说明的开放集人物描述. 然而,它并没有为人类行动提供开放的设定标题,而人类行动是了解人与对象相互作用所必需的。
最后,MEVA([8])是一个以人和团体为中心的数据集,它具有个人和团体活动的活动标签. 然而,这一数据集提供的活动范围非常有限,而且更具体地用于监测。 总之,现有的数据集要么缺乏开放式的-设定标题,要么省略了每个人的定位,要么仅限于单一的-人或封闭的-设定情景,激发对AVA-描述的需求.

blocks.en:
Human Activity Recognition Methods: Human activity recognition (HAR) is an essential component of fields like home assistants, embodied AI and assistive technology, and is gaining traction in Deep Learning (DL) literature ( [ 29 , 11 , 6 ] ).
Recent deep learning approaches treat HAR as a specialized form of video understanding, but often under constrained settings. ( [ 33 , 13 , 32 , 12 ] ). For instance, ( [ 33 ] ) combines local and global video processing to capture activity cues, but assumes only one person is present. ( [ 12 ] ) performs large-scale pretraining for caption generation from videos. But this method is not necessarily human-centric and is more suited toward scene description rather than human action description. ( [ 13 ] ) focuses on recognizing activities of people as a group rather than focus on individual actions, whereas ( [ 4 ] ) focuses on HAR using the human pose. Some papers also approach this problem by predefining action classes and trying to classify human actions in one of these classes ( [ 8 , 16 , 4 , 20 ] ). As opposed to these methods, which employ a relaxed setting for HAR, we are one of the first methods to propose the HAR task in a more unconstrained way, allowing open-set captions, and human-attributed action recognition that allows multiple people in the field of view.

人类活动表彰 方法:人类活动认识(HAR)是家庭助理等领域的一个基本组成部分,它体现了AI和辅助技术,并正在深入学习(DL)文献中得到推动([29,11,6]).
最近的深入学习方法将HAR视为一种专门的视频理解形式,但往往在受限制的环境下进行。 ([33、13、32、12]) 例如,([33])结合本地和全球的视频处理来捕捉活动提示,但假设只有一个人在场. ([12])进行大规模预训,从视频生成字幕. 但这种方法不一定以人为中心,更适合场景描述而非人类动作描述. ([13])侧重于承认人们作为一个群体的活动,而不是侧重于个人行动,而([4])侧重于使用人的姿势的哈尔。 一些论文也通过预先确定行动类别和试图将人类行动归入其中一个类别来解决这一问题([8、16、4、20])。 与这些对HAR使用宽松设置的方法相比,我们是最早提出HAR任务的方法之一,它更不受约束,允许开放的设定标题,以及人类属性的动作识别,允许在视野中多人.

blocks.en: 3 AVA-Captions Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 AVA- Captions 数据集

blocks.en: Existing datasets focus on a single person or focus on a closed set of classes, as shown in Table 1 . To address these limitations, we construct AVA - Captions, a large - scale benchmark for open - set, per - person appearance and activity description in video. We build AVA - Captions from AVA - Actions v2.2 ( [ 9 ] ), which contains 15 - minute annotated segments for 235 training and 64 validation videos. Each segment includes frame - level bounding boxes and action labels for every visible person, identified by a unique Person ID (PID), with actions drawn from 80 predefined classes. To create training samples, we segment each annotated video into 10 - second clips with a maximum overlap of 5s, yielding approximately 36.8K training and 11.1K testing clips from the original training and validation splits. As AVA - Actions does not release test - set annotations, we do not use its official test split.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,现有的数据集侧重于一个人或侧重于封闭的一组类别。 为解决这些局限性,我们构建了AVA - Captions,一个大型尺度基准,用于视频中的开放式-设定,人均外观和活动描述. 我们建造了AVA - 来自AVA的说明 - Actions v2.2 ([9]),包含235个培训的15分钟注释片段和64个验证视频. 每个片段包括帧 - 每一个可见人物的平面边框和动作标签,由独特的人物ID(PID)识别,动作取自80个预定义的类. 为了制作培训样本,我们把每段附加说明的视频分成10至2个片段,最多重叠5个片段,产生大约36.8K培训,11.1K测试片段来自最初的培训和验证片段。 由于 AVA - 动作不释放测试 - 设置说明, 我们不使用它的官方测试拆分 。

blocks.en: Once we have the extracted clips, we use a large VLM (called Expert-VLM) - Nova Pro ( [ 1 ] ), to generate separate captions for person and activity descriptions for each person in the clip. For the person description, we provide the video along with an image crop extracted using the bounding box around the person to the VLM and prompt it to generate a caption describing the person including their apparel, age and location (for eg. a child in red hat standing near the stairs ). For the activity description, we also provide the activity labels provided in the original dataset to the expert VLM and ask it to construct a complete caption for the activity of the person using the video and the action labels. The exact prompts used for this process are provided in the supplementary. This method can be adapted for other datasets as well to generate dense person-specific captions in the future.
blocks.zh: 一旦我们拿到提取的剪辑,我们就会使用一个大型的VLM(称为专家-VLM)-Nova Pro([1]),为剪辑中的每个人生成单独的人物标题和活动描述. 为了描述个人情况,我们提供录像,以及用人周围的边框提取的图像作物,并促使它制作一个描述个人的字幕,包括他们的服装、年龄和位置(例如站在楼梯附近的一名戴红帽子的儿童)。 对于活动描述,我们还向专家VLM提供原始数据集中提供的活动标签,并要求其为使用视频和动作标签的人的活动构建完整的标题. 补充部分提供了这一过程所用的确切提示。 这种方法可以适用于其他数据集,也可以在未来生成密集的针对个人的字幕.

blocks.en:
However, there is one more concern regarding the AVA-Actions dataset. From our observations, we found that the same person is often assigned multiple PIDs. This occurs when the camera pans away from a person and comes back to the same person, who is then detected as a new entity. This causes the data to have multiple repeated entries for different PIDs since they represent the same person. To address this, we apply a Person-ReID-based filter using the torchreid library ( [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] ). If the image crop corresponding to a given PID has a ReID similarity score greater than 0.75 0.75 with any previous PID, then we merge them and retain the previous PID. We use the Expert-VLM to merge the captions so that there is no repetition. Some examples are shown in Figure 2 . We manually validated 1,000 randomly sampled datapoints to assess the quality of captions generated by the VLM. For each video, we examined whether: 1. all ground-truth action labels were incorporated into the caption, 2. individuals were described accurately, 3. the annotated actions were correctly reflected, and 4. the same person was consistently assigned a single subject ID. Our evaluation revealed that in approximately 95% of cases, the VLM successfully utilized all action labels and produced accurate person and activity descriptions.
However, in roughly 15% of cases, the captions contained repeated actions, primarily due to duplicated action labels across timestamps in the original dataset. In addition, for around 15% of the cases, the same subject was still given multiple PIDs. Adjusting the ReID similarity score threshold to 0.85 0.85 increased this number to  20%, whereas changing it to 0.65 0.65 led to false merging of distinct entities into a single subject ID for around 30% cases. Thus, we choose 0.75 0.75 as the threshold. While we note that VLM-based generation may introduce minor biases, our manual inspection suggests that such artifacts are limited and can be treated as noise without significantly impacting model development. Additional examples and dataset statistics are provided in the supplementary.

blocks.en: 4.3 CAMP Phase 2
blocks.zh: 4.3 国家方案 第2阶段

blocks.en: During Phase 1 training, we constrain the attention masks for each individual, encouraging the model to generate appearance and activity captions by focusing primarily on the local context surrounding the person. While effective for learning localized descriptions, this setup has two key limitations: (i) activities that inherently depend on global context—such as interactions with other people or distant objects—cannot be captured accurately under strict local constraints; and (ii) constructing person-specific attention masks requires knowing the exact mapping between output tokens and individuals, which is feasible during training but impractical at inference. A potential workaround would involve dynamically monitoring each generated token and updating the attention mask whenever a new subject is introduced, but this approach significantly increases inference complexity and latency, rendering Phase 1 alone unsuitable for deployment.
blocks.zh: 在第一阶段的训练中,我们限制每个人的注意口罩,鼓励该模型主要关注个人的局部环境,从而产生外观和活动标题。 这种设置虽然对学习本地化的描述有效,但有两个关键局限:(一) 必然取决于全球背景的活动——例如与其他人或遥远物体的互动——在严格的本地限制下无法准确捕捉到;和(二) 构建针对个人的注意面罩需要了解产出标志与个人之间的精确分布图,这在培训期间是可行的,但在推断中是不切实际的。 潜在的变通办法包括动态监测每个生成的标物,并在引入新主题时更新注意罩,但这种方法大大增加推论的复杂性和耐久性,使第一阶段本身不适合部署。

blocks.en: To address these issues, Phase 2 training removes the constraints and fine-tunes the model with the default attention mask (Figure 3 ) at a reduced learning rate. This continuation serves two purposes: it enables the model to incorporate global contextual cues while learning to generate outputs under the standard attention mechanism. At the same time, a lower learning rate ensures that that the attention weights of the model are not changed drastically so that the model still focuses on the regions around the person of interest. Together, these phases yield a model that balances localized grounding with global contextual reasoning, while remaining practical for inference.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,第二阶段培训消除了限制,并用默认的注意力罩(图3)以较低的学习率对模型进行微调. 这一延续有两个目的:它使模型能够纳入全球背景提示,同时学会在标准关注机制下产生产出。 同时,较低的学习率确保模型的注意力权重不会发生急剧变化,从而使模型仍然侧重于感兴趣的人周围的区域。 这些阶段共同产生了一种模式,在局部定位与全球背景推理之间保持平衡,同时对推论仍然切合实际。

blocks.en: 4.4 Motivation
blocks.zh: 4.4 动机

blocks.en:
We observed that when training a VLM on our dataset, the model frequently confused actions performed by different individuals (for example, action done by person B predicted for person A). To mitigate this, we introduce the CAMP framework, built on the hypothesis that for describing a person’s actions and appearance, the local context surrounding the individual is generally sufficient, without requiring attention to the entire scene. By masking tokens outside the region of interest, the model is encouraged to learn mappings between localized visual features and their corresponding textual descriptions.
While this hypothesis holds in many cases, modifying attention maps dynamically during inference is impractical. To address this limitation, we introduce Phase 2 training, where the constraints are removed and the model is fine-tuned with a reduced learning rate. Prior work has shown that lower learning rates yield more conservative weight updates and stabilize training ( [ 15 , 5 ] ). This second phase enables the model to incorporate global context while preserving its focus on the regions of interest, thereby eliminating the need for attention map modifications at inference time.

我们观察到,在对数据集进行虚拟LM培训时,该模型经常混淆不同个人采取的行动(例如,B人为A人预测采取的行动)。 为了缓解这种情况,我们提出了CAMP框架,这个框架建立在假设基础上,即为了描述一个人的行为和外表,围绕个人的局部背景一般是足够的,不需要关注整个场景. 通过在感兴趣的区域之外伪装标志,鼓励模型学习本地视觉特征与其相应的文字描述之间的绘图.
虽然这一假设在许多情况下存在,但在推论期间动态修改关注图是不切实际的. 为解决这一限制,我们引进了第二阶段培训,取消了限制,对模式进行了微调,降低了学习率。 以前的工作表明,较低的学习率产生更保守的重量更新和稳定培训([15,5])。 这一第二阶段使该模式能够纳入全球背景,同时继续关注感兴趣的区域,从而消除了在推断时对关注图进行修改的必要性。

Comparison with Similar Scale VLMs: We perform experiments on the HC-STVG and AVA-Captions datasets with baseline, open-source VLMs and our CAMP method. The experimental setup is detailed in the supplementary. We tabulate the results of CAMP with InternVL3-1B [ 7 ] and Qwen2.5VL-3B [ 2 ] backbone as compared to similar open source baselines in Tables 3 and 2 . We see a clear improvement in all classical and embedding-based metrics for both datasets. Table 2 evaluates the model prediction for subject description while Table 3 evaluates the model prediction for activity description. As described before, the output is of the format: A = “ PID 1 . c P 1 : c A 1 ; … PID S . c P S : c A S ; " A=\text{``}\text{PID}_{1}.\text{ }c^{P}_{1}\text{ : }c^{A}_{1}\text{; }...\text{PID}_{S}.\text{ }c^{P}_{S}\text{ : }c^{A}_{S}\text{; }\text{"} . We separate this output into subject description and activity description using the colon delimiter. For different subjects, we use the PID to map the predictions to the ground truth. The computed metrics are averaged across all videos and subjects. As compared to the LLAVA-One Vision (LLAVA-OV) baseline ( [ 17 , 19 ] ), which offers a 0.5 B model, we see a significant improvement with InternVL3 1B model. While some of this can be attributed to the more number of parameters (since LLAVA-OV does not offer 1B model), the multimodal encoder structure in InternVL3 ( [ 7 ] ) style of models also plays a significant part. Unlike LLAVA, both InternVL3 and Qwen support frame-level injection, enabling bounding boxes to be passed separately for each frame. This design yields consistent improvements, which are further amplified by our CAMP framework through constrained attention in Phase 1 and unconstrained fine-tuning in Phase 2. Interestingly, we observe greater relative improvements for the smaller InternVL3 - 1B backbone compared to the larger Qwen2.5VL - 3B. This is expected: larger models can already capture complex functions, making constrained training less impactful, whereas smaller models benefit more from CAMP’s inductive bias.
Due to compute limitations, we were unable to compare with larger-scale models. However, we emphasize that the proposed task is most relevant for home assistants and surveillance systems, where inference typically occurs on edge devices. For this reason, our study focuses on small- to medium-scale models, which are more practical for such applications.

blocks.en: Ablation on Relaxation of Bounding Box: During the attention masking in Phase 1 of CAMP, we use a relaxed bounding box around the person to capture local context for predicting activity. We expand it by 100% of the width on each side and by 20% of the height on each side based on the observation that humans are generally taller than wider. Hence, the bounding box around them captures lesser context along the width than the height. Thus, for the relaxed bounding box, we expand it more along the width. For added validation, we vary the proportions of these relaxations in Table 4 . We observe that increasing the context in width is more effective than height as expected.
blocks.zh: 关于放松边界箱的规定: 在CAMP第一阶段的注意力蒙蔽过程中,我们使用一个围绕人物的宽松的边框来捕捉局部背景来预测活动. 根据人类一般比宽度高的观察,我们把每边的宽度扩大100%,每边的高度扩大20%. 因此,它们周围的边框在宽度上比在高度上要小。 因此,对于宽松的边框,我们沿着宽度扩大。 为了补充验证,我们改变表4中这些放松的比例。 我们认为,增加宽度比预期的高度更有效。

blocks.en: Metric Definition: Text-text matching or embedding similarity metrics are inherently tied to the specific ground truth (GT) annotations ( [ 21 ] ). As a result, they can undervalue predictions that are semantically correct but differ lexically from the GT, or that capture details omitted in the annotation. For example, consider Figure 5 which contains low-scoring predictions from our model. However, it can be seen from the video frame that the events described by the prediction are actually happening and noteworthy. We provide more such examples in the supplementary. This highlights a limitation: existing metrics cannot directly verify whether a predicted caption is factually grounded in the visual content. To address this, we propose using a large-scale model to act as a judge, given the actual video and the predictions. Thus, these metrics are computed without knowing the GT captions and designed to complement, rather than replace, the classical measures. More specifically, given a video, an image crop of the target subject, and the predicted caption, we query Nova - Pro v1 ( [ 1 ] ) as well as Qwen2.5 VL 32B ( [ 2 ] ) to assign a score from 1–5 (higher is better) for each of the following: 1. Subject / Activity Correctness (CRT): How much of the predicted caption is actually present in the video for the given subject. CRT measures factual alignment of the prediction with the video content. 2. Subject / Activity Completeness (CMP): How much of the subject description / activity is described by the caption. CMP measures whether all relevant actions are captured by the prediction. 3. Subject Uniqueness (UNQ): How discriminative is the predicted subject description in identifying the subject. UNQ measures ambiguity in the predicted caption. CRT and CMP are analogous to precision and recall, respectively whereas UNQ is motivated for practical use cases and its definition is dependent on the video. For example, if a predicted caption reads: “The man : opens the door", it can be considered highly unique for describing the subject if there is only one man in the video, but not at all unique when there are multiple men in the video. We believe that UNQ is a better metric than CMP for subject description for practical purposes. In addition, CMP is ill-defined especially for the subject description since there can be various ways of describing the same person. While this is also true for the activities, CMP gives an approximate measure of whether all important activities are captured by the model and so we retain it as a metric. Some examples are shown in Figure 5 . Based on these definitions, we compute (i) the average CRT, (ii) average CMP, (iii) average UNQ and (iv) accuracy based on C ​ R ​ T ≥ 4 ​ AND ​ U ​ N ​ Q ≥ 3 CRT\geq 4\text{ AND }UNQ\geq 3 for subject and C ​ R ​ T ≥ 4 ​ AND ​ C ​ M ​ P ≥ 3 CRT\geq 4\text{ AND }CMP\geq 3 for activity (Acc), as VLM-based metrics. The full prompt used for querying the VLM for computing these metrics is provided in the supplementary.

blocks.en: Comparison with Similar Scale VLMs: We tabulate the subject description metrics in Table 5 using Nova Pro v1 and Qwen2.5 VL 32B as expert models respectively. Table 6 show activity caption metrics using Nova Pro v1 and Qwen2.5 VL 32B as expert models respectively. We see that our method consistently outperforms baselines and is able to produce better and more comprehensive outputs as shown in Figure 4 . Even though the average CRT, UNQ, or CMP rise slightly, it generates a significant difference in accuracy after thresholding, which is due to the discrete nature of the VLM-based metrics. As seen in the examples, constrained attention using CAMP can guide the VLM towards localizing actions for a given individual instead of getting confused with the global context alone. For example, without CAMP, InternVL3 confuses between the two PIDs, whereas LLAVA-OV confuses the person description.

blocks.en: Limitations: Recent works have shown the effectiveness of using VLMs as judges [ 10 , 14 ] where the proximity of the VLM results to the human results is heavily dependent on the prompt. However, VLMs can introduce inherent bias in their results as described in detail in the supplementary. Hence, we recommend using VLM-based metrics for relative comparison between models rather than the absolute performance of a single model.
blocks.zh: 限制:近期的作品显示将VLMs作为判断器[10,14]的有效性,其中VLM结果与人类结果的接近性严重依赖于及时性. 然而,如补充报告所详细描述的,VLM可以在结果中引入固有的偏差. 因此,我们建议使用基于VLM的衡量标准来比较模型,而不是单一模型的绝对性能。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce the task of Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition and propose a dataset called Ava-Captions for the same by modifying the AVA-Actions dataset. In order to effectively use the grounding information in this task, we propose the CAMP method that constrains the attention mask during training, thereby directing the model to focus more on the local context around a person to better caption their description and activity. Finally, we propose VLM-based metrics that directly compares predicted captions with the content of the video instead of incomplete human annotations and serves as a complement to classical metrics. A limitation in the VLM-based metric is that it is highly dependent on the ability of the VQA to understand the video and the instruction. With this work, we want to encourage future research in the human-attributed video understanding tasks that can be useful for various applications.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了 " 地面人类属性描述和活动识别 " 的任务,并通过修改AVA-Actions数据集,提出一个名为Ava-Capitions的数据集。 为了有效地利用这一任务中的基础信息,我们提出CAMP方法,在训练期间限制注意面罩,从而引导模型更注重围绕一个人的局部背景,以更好地描述他们的描述和活动. 最后,我们提出基于VLM的衡量标准,直接将预测标题与视频内容进行比较,而不是不完整的人类说明,并作为经典衡量标准的补充。 以VLM为基础的衡量标准的一个局限性是,它高度依赖于VQA理解视频和指令的能力. 有了这项工作,我们想鼓励今后对人性化的视频理解任务进行研究,这些任务可能对各种应用有用.

blocks.en: We use Nova Pro v1 as an expert model to generate full captions about person and activity descriptions, given the video, cropped image of the person and the activity labels provided in the AVA-Actions dataset. For multiple people in the video, the expert model is run for each person and the resulting captions are merged. The exact prompt used for this purpose is as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们使用Nova Pro v1作为专家模型来生成关于人物和活动描述的完整字幕,因为视频,裁剪了人物的图像以及AVA-Actions数据集中提供的活动标签. 对于视频中的多人,专家模型为每个人运行,由此而来的标题被合并. 用于这一目的的准确提示如下:

blocks.en: <VIDEO> <PERSON-CROP> This is a 10 seconds video and an image. Consider the person in the image. The action labels associated with the person in the video are given by “ <ACTION1> , <ACTION2> ,…". These actions describe only one person. Describe the selected person in regards to clothing, location or other surprising appearance, for example "Sitting blindfolded woman in a black suit". Use all the action labels to create an activity caption only for the selected person in the video while maintaining the temporal action order. The output should be in the format: <person description> : <activity caption> . For example, "Blindfolded woman in black suit: sits on a chair, gets up, opens the door, hugs the man at the door and walks out".Structure the action caption in a conceptual manner, with slightly more focus on the meaning of actions rather than simple words.
blocks.zh: "VIDEO " "个人-中心 " 这是一个10秒的视频和图像。 考虑人物形象. 视频中与人物相关的动作标签由“<ACTION1>,<ACTION2>,......”给出. 这些行动只描述了一个人。 在服装、位置或其他令人惊讶的外表方面描述被选中的人,例如“穿黑色西装的被蒙上眼睛的妇女”。 使用所有动作标签只为视频中选中的人创建活动标题,同时维持时间动作命令. 输出格式应为: " 人物描述 " : " 活动标题 " 。 例如"穿黑西装的被包裹着的女人:坐在椅子上,站起来,打开门,抱男人在门前走出去". 动作标题的结构是概念性的,略多关注动作的意义,而不是简单的单词.

blocks.en: 2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 2 实验设置

blocks.en: We perform experiments on the HC-STVG and AVA-Captions datasets with baseline, open-source VLMs and our CAMP method. We use 3 A100-SXM4s for our experiments with a batch size of 3. We use an image size of 448X448 and sample 10 equidistant frames from the video. Since most videos are 10 seconds long, this essentially corresponds to an effective sampling rate of 1 FPS. For evaluation, we calculate the subject and activity metrics separately. Subject metrics evaluate the predicted human appearance captions and activity metrics evaluate the predicted activity captions against the ground truth. We use the standard metrics for text-text comparison, namely BLEU4 ( [ 22 ] ), ROUGE ( [ 18 ] ) and METEOR ( [ 3 ] ). In addition, we also calculate the embedding similarity metrics namely CLIP Similarity Score (CSS) and SBert Similarity Score (SbSS). For these, we compute the CLIP ( [ 24 ] ) embeddings and SentenceBert ( [ 25 ] ) embeddings, respectively, for the predicted caption and the ground truth caption, and compute the cosine similarity between the two.
blocks.zh: 我们在HC-STVG和AVA-Captions数据集上进行实验,这些数据集具有基线、开源VLM和我们的CAMP方法。 我们用3台A100-SXM4进行实验,批量尺寸为3. 我们使用448X448的图像大小 从视频中抽取10个等距框 由于大多数视频长达10秒,这基本上相当于1 FPS的有效采样率. 为了评估,我们分别计算主题和活动指标。 主题衡量标准评价预测的人类外表说明和活动衡量标准对照地面真相评价预测的活动说明。 我们使用标准衡量标准进行文本与文本的比较,即BLEU4([22])、ROUGE([18])和METEOR([3])。 此外,我们还计算了嵌入式类似度量衡,即CLIP相似度分(CSS)和SBert相似度分(SbSS). 对于这些,我们分别计算预言标题和地面真实标题的CLIP([24])嵌入和句贝特([25])嵌入,并计算两者的余弦相似性.

blocks.en: 4 Ablation on Phases of CAMP
blocks.zh: 4 有关CAMP阶段的规定

blocks.en: We perform an ablation with just Phase 1 of CAMP, where we apply constrained attention masking during training as well as inference on HC-STVG and AVA-Captions dataset. The results are shown in Table 2 . During inference, we keep a conditional statement at every step of the generation that checks for special tokens for change of subject and modifies the attention mask accordingly. However, we find significantly lower scores on both datasets. This is not surprising since false outputs can lead to false attention masks for all the tokens after the false output.
blocks.zh: 我们用CAMP的第一阶段进行减速,在培训期间我们使用有限的注意力遮盖,并对HC-STVG和AVA-Capitions数据集进行推论。 结果见表2。 在推论中,我们在一代人的每一步都保留一个有条件的语句,用于检查特殊符号,用于改变对象,并相应修改注意罩. 然而,我们发现两个数据集的分数都低得多。 这并不奇怪,因为假输出可能导致假输出后所有信物的假注意口罩.

blocks.en: 5 Motivating the need for VLM-metrics
blocks.zh: 页:1 激发对VLM计量技术的需求

blocks.en: We present more examples of cases where the ground truth for a given subject in a video lexically differs from the equally correct predictions in Figures 2 and 3 . A video contains a lot of information, not all of which is captured by a human annotator in most cases. Thus, classical metrics which directly compare with these are significantly pessimistic. This motivates the need for VLM-based metrics, where the video is directly analyzed to assess the predicted caption.
blocks.zh: 我们举出更多例子,说明录像中某一对象的基本真相与图2和图3中同样正确的预测不同。 一段视频包含大量信息,在多数情况下,并非所有信息都被人类注释者捕获. 因此,直接与之比较的经典衡量标准相当悲观。 这促使需要基于VLM的度量标准,在此对视频进行直接分析,以评估预测的字幕.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : A limiting case of VLM-based evaluation metrics. CMP and UNQ are pessimistically given a score of 1 even though the predicted caption describes the person uniquely and describes some of the activities of the subject.
blocks.zh: 图 3:一个以VLM为基础的评价指标的有限案例。 《议定书》/《公约》缔约方会议和联合国总部悲观地给出了1分的分数,尽管预测标题对当事人作了独特的描述,并描述了这一主题的一些活动。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations of VLM-based Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6 以VLM为基础的评价的局限性

blocks.en: While foundation models today perform extremely well for visual understanding tasks, using them for evaluation can still induce biases in the result. Consider the example shown in Figure 3 . Here, the caption describes the subject as “the standing man". Since no other men are standing in the video, it should get a high UNQ value, which is not the case. Similarly, some of the activities of the person are accurately described, yet the VLM gives the lowest CMP scores to the prediction. In our observation, especially for CMP and UNQ, the VLM is biased towards more pessimistic values for these metrics.
blocks.zh: 虽然今天的基础模型在视觉理解任务方面表现极佳,但利用这些模型进行评价仍然会引起结果的偏差。 考虑图3所示的例子。 在这里,标题将这一主题描述为“站立的人”。 由于录像中没有其他男子站立,它应该具有很高的联合国总部价值,但情况并非如此。 同样,个人的一些活动也得到了准确的描述,然而VLM给出了预测的最低CMP分数. 在我们的意见中,特别是对《议定书》/《公约》缔约方会议和联合国总部的意见中,VLM偏向于这些衡量标准更悲观的数值。

blocks.en: Thus, while VLMs offer crucial insights complementing the classical metrics, it is best to use the VLM-metrics for relative comparison between models rather than absolute performance of a model.
blocks.zh: 因此,虽然VLMs提供了补充经典度量衡的重要见解,但最好使用VLM度量衡来比较模型,而不是模型的绝对性能.

blocks.en: 7 Prompt for VLM-based Metrics
blocks.zh: 7 基于 VLM 的计量提示

blocks.en: We used the Nova Pro v1 model to generate the CRT, CMP, and UNQ metrics. Since UNQ is not suitable for activity metrics, we run the VLM separately for the subject and the activity. Since HC-STVG dataset has annotations for only a certain portion of the video, we also provide the starting and ending timestamp in the prompt. The exact prompts are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们使用Nova Pro v1模型生成CRT,CMP,和UNQ的度量衡. 由于联合国总部不适合活动衡量标准,因此我们为主题和活动分别运行VLM. 由于HC-STVG数据集仅对视频的某一部分有说明,因此我们也在提示中提供了始末时间戳. 具体提示如下:

blocks.en: Subject: Consider only t= <start time> to t= <end time> seconds in the video. Consider only the appearance related details of the Person ID 1: <subject description from ground truth> . Next, consider this candidate caption which we want to evaluate against your caption and the events that are discernible from the video from t= <start time> to t= <end time> seconds:“ <predicted subject> "
blocks.zh: 主题:在视频中只考虑t="开始时间"到t="结束时间"秒. 只考虑个人身份证1的外观细节: " 从地面真相看主题描述 " 。 其次,请参照您的字幕以及从t= <启动时间>到t= <结束时间 > 秒的视频中可以看到的事件来考虑我们想评估的这一候选字幕:“预计主题”

blocks.en: Your task is to rate the candidate caption for Person ID 1 in the video on a scale of 1 to 5 for each of the following criteria and rating scale INDEPENDENTLY.
blocks.zh: 您的任务是将视频中个人ID 1 的候选字幕评分为 1 到 5 级, 分以下标准和评分等级为 INDEPENTY 。

blocks.en: Evaluation Criteria:- Completeness: How completely does the caption cover all the relevant and essential aspects of Person ID 1 in the video?
blocks.zh: 评价标准: - 完整性: 标题如何完整地涵盖录像中个人身份证1的所有相关和基本方面?

blocks.en: Rating Scale:
blocks.zh: 评分比例 :

blocks.en: - 1 Very Low Completeness: The caption includes almost none of the important attributes for the person, missing most details.
blocks.zh: - 1个极低完整性: 标题几乎不包含个人的重要属性,缺少大部分细节.

blocks.en: - 5 Extremely High Completeness: The caption fully covers all relevant and essential aspects, leaving no important details unaddressed.
blocks.zh: - 5 高度完整性: 标题充分涵盖了所有相关和基本方面,没有未解决的重要细节。

blocks.en: Evaluation Criterion: - Correctness: How accurately does the caption describe the aspects and activities of Person ID 1?
blocks.zh: 评价标准: - 正确性:标题如何准确描述个人身份证1的方面和活动?

blocks.en: Rating Scale: - 1 Very Low Correctness: The caption is mostly or entirely incorrect; The person cannot be described by any or most of the predicted attributes
blocks.zh: 评分比例 : - 1个非常低的正确性: 标题大多或完全不正确; 无法用任何或大多数预测属性描述人物

blocks.en: - 5 Extremely High Correctness: All attributes mentioned in the predicted caption belong to the person in the video.
blocks.zh: - 5 极高正确性:预测标题中提到的所有属性都属于视频中的人。

blocks.en: Note that a caption may be correct but not complete and vice-versa. For example, if a caption has 2 attributes while the person requires 6 attributes to be uniquely defined, it is low complete. But if those 2 predicted attributes actually belong to the person, it has extremely high correctness. Similarly, if the predicted caption has 3 attributes and the person has only one of them and nothing else, the caption has high completeness since the actual attribute was captured, but low correctness because incorrect attributes were also predicted. Thus, completeness is similar to recall and correctness is similar to precision.
blocks.zh: 注意标题可能正确但不完整,反之亦然。 例如,如果一个标题有2个属性,而人则需要6个属性进行独特的定义,那么它就不够完整了. 但是,如果这两个预测的属性实际上属于人,那么它具有极高的正确性. 同样,如果预言标题有3个属性,且人物只有其中之一且没有其他任何属性,则标题自实际属性被捕捉后就具有很高的完整性,但由于不正确的属性也被预言,所以其准确性较低. 因此,完整性与召回类似,正确性与精确性类似.

blocks.en: Evaluation Criterion: - Uniqueness: First, look at the different people in the video. Given the candidate caption, how easy it is to locate Person ID 1 in the video? Note that a simple caption can be highly discriminative. For example, if the video has only men and one woman, a caption like "a woman" is extremely unique as it can only be used to describe that one woman in the video.
blocks.zh: 评价标准: - 独特性:第一,看视频中不同的人. 鉴于候选人的字幕,在视频中找到个人身份证1有多容易? 请注意,简单的标题可能具有高度的歧视性。 例如,如果视频只有男性和一个女性,那么像"一个女性"这样的字幕是极其独特的,因为它只能用来描述视频中的那个女性.

blocks.en: Rating Scale:
blocks.zh: 评分比例 :

blocks.en: - 1 Very Low Uniqueness: The same caption can be used to describe multiple entities in the video
blocks.zh: - 1个非常低 独特性:同一标题可用于描述视频中的多个实体

blocks.en: - 5 Extremely Uniqueness: There cannot be any shred of doubt about which person from the video is being described by the caption.’
blocks.zh: - 5个极端 独特性:影片中哪些人被字幕描述, ' ' 说

blocks.en: Activity: Consider only t= <start time> to t= <end time> seconds in the video. Consider only the activities of the Person ID 1: <subject description from ground truth> . Next, consider this candidate caption which we want to evaluate against your caption and the events that are discernible from the video from t= <start time> to t= <end time> seconds: “ <predicted activity caption> "
blocks.zh: 活动:在视频中仅考虑t="开始时间"到t="结束时间"秒. 仅考虑个人身份证1的活动: " 从事实出发的主体描述 " 。 接下来,请参照您的标题以及从t= <启动时间>到t= <结束时间 > 秒的视频中可以看到的事件来考虑我们想评估的这一候选标题:“<预计活动标题>”

blocks.en: Your task is to rate the candidate caption for Person ID 1 in the video for each of the following criteria and rating scales INDEPENDENTLY.
blocks.zh: 您的任务是在录像中为以下每项标准和评分等级进行评分:

blocks.en: Evaluation Criteria:- Completeness: How completely does the caption cover all the relevant activities of Person ID 1 in the video?
blocks.zh: 评价标准: - 完整性: 字幕如何完整地涵盖视频中个人身份证1的所有相关活动?

blocks.en: Rating Scale:
blocks.zh: 评分比例 :

blocks.en: - 1 Very Low Completeness: The caption includes almost none of the important activities, missing most activity details.
blocks.zh: - 1个极低完整性: 标题几乎不包含任何重要活动,遗漏了大多数活动的细节。

blocks.en: - 5 Extremely High Completeness: The caption fully covers all relevant and essential aspects, leaving no important details unaddressed.
blocks.zh: - 5 高度完整性: 标题充分涵盖了所有相关和基本方面,没有未解决的重要细节。

blocks.en: Evaluation Criterion: - Correctness: How accurate is the caption regarding the activities of Person ID 1?
blocks.zh: 评价标准: - 正确性:关于人证1活动的标题有多准确?

blocks.en: Rating Scale:
blocks.zh: 评分比例 :

blocks.en: - 1 Very Low Correctness: The caption is mostly or entirely incorrect; The person is not doing any or most of the predicted activities
blocks.zh: - 1个非常低的正确性: 标题大多或完全不正确; 该人没有从事任何或大多数预测的活动

blocks.en: - 5 Extremely High Correctness: Almost all activities mentioned in the predicted caption are done by the person in the video.
blocks.zh: - 5 高度正确性:预测标题中提到的几乎所有活动都由视频中的人完成。

blocks.en: Note that a caption may be correct but not complete and vice-versa. For example, if a caption has 2 activities while the person is doing 6 activities, it is low complete. But if those 2 predicted activities are actually done by the person, it has extremely high correctness. Similarly, if the predicted caption has 3 activities and the person is doing only one of them, the caption has high completeness since the actual activity was captured, but low correctness because incorrect activities were also predicted. Thus, completeness is similar to recall and correctness is similar to precision.
blocks.zh: 注意标题可能正确但不完整,反之亦然。 例如,如果一个标题在某人进行6项活动时有2项活动,则该标题的完成程度较低。 但是,如果这2个预测的活动实际上是由个人完成的,那么它具有极高的正确性. 同样,如果预测的标题有3项活动,而该人只从事其中一项活动,则标题自实际活动被捕获以来就具有很高的完整性,但准确性较低,因为预测的活动也不正确。 因此,完整性与召回类似,正确性与精确性类似.
